        if obj.get("TOCHeading") == heading:
            return obj
        for k, v in obj.items():
            res = find_section(v, heading)
            if res:
                return res
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for item in obj:
            res = find_section(item, heading)
            if res:
                return res
    return None
